en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Musa Bin Al Qasim, from Yahya Bin Masour, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Al-Suweyq gets rid of the bile and the phlegm from the stomach with a stripping, and repels seventy types from the types of the afflictions’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bandar has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Musa ibn al-Qasim from Yahya ibn Musawir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
sawiq removes bitterness (bile) and phlegm from the stomach and dispels seventy kinds of illness.’”
